requirements.verifier_assertion: result.json is produced at /app/result.json with four top-level keys: scored_runs, incomplete_runs, rejected, summary
result.json contains no absolute paths, IPs, URLs, tokens, or usernames
summary has scored_count, incomplete_count, rejected_count (correct lengths), and best_run_id = run_id at position 0 of scored_runs
composite computed as round(sum_m(weights[m]*S_m), decimals) using Python banker's rounding; S_m = direction[m]*(value_canonical - baseline[m])/scale[m]
area values with unit mm2 are multiplied by 1e6 to convert to canonical um2; um2 values used as-is
each component S_m and the composite are rounded to `decimals` places (value 4 from scoring_config.json)
effective stage is determined by the run's `stage` field, not the folder it was found in
when same run_id appears at both draft and final effective stages, the final record fully replaces the draft
all copies of a run_id that appear more than once within the same effective stage are rejected with reason duplicate_in_stage
runs with any metric missing or null become incomplete entries; missing field lists absent metric names sorted ascending
scored_runs entries have run_id, status='scored', composite, and components object with wns/area/traj
rejected entries have run_id and reason; same-stage duplicate reason is exactly the string duplicate_in_stage
scored_runs sorted by composite descending; ties broken by run_id ascending
incomplete_runs and rejected each sorted by run_id ascending; within each incomplete entry, missing list sorted ascending
must_include: missing list is also sorted ascending
